name: Minimal House
about: Minimal house is house with everything inessential removed: a kick, a handful of percussion hits, a bass pulse, and one or two sounds doing a lot of work across ten minutes. It grew out of Detroit's Daniel Bell and Robert Hood, Cologne's Kompakt and Frankfurt's Perlon in the late 1990s, then became the dominant sound of Berlin and Ibiza around 2005, when Ricardo Villalobos, Richie Hawtin's Minus crew, Luciano's Cadenza and clubs like Panorama Bar made reduction the fashion. Trentemøller, Booka Shade and Matthew Dear gave it melodies and album form; the Romanian producers around Rhadoo and Petre Inspirescu took it deeper and stranger in the 2010s. It is music for long nights and good sound systems, and it rewards patience more than any other house style.

albums.title: Volksworld
albums.why: The Poker Flat founder's debut is reduced, funky German house, and the quiet template for a decade of minimal from Hamburg and Berlin.

albums.title: Rest
albums.why: Beau Mot Plage and its album made minimal house humane and melodic, and Playhouse's catalogue never bettered it.

albums.title: Immer
albums.why: The Kompakt mix that defined melancholy minimal house, sequenced like a pop album and still the label's calling card.

albums.title: Blip, Blurp, Bleep: The Music of Daniel Bell
albums.why: Logistic's compilation of Bell's DBX singles, Losing Control included; the Detroit source of minimal house in one place.

albums.title: Pony Slaystation
albums.why: Zip and Sammy Dee's Perlon album is the label's house sound at its most playful, elastic grooves and odd little melodies.

albums.title: Leave Luck to Heaven
albums.why: Dear sang over his own skeletal minimal house, with Dog Days as the hit, and gave Ghostly its first essential album.

albums.title: Alcachofa
albums.why: The record that made minimal house psychedelic: Easy Lee, Dexter and an hour of grooves that drift, stutter and never resolve; the genre's landmark.

albums.title: The Absence of Blight
albums.why: Dial's house at its most wistful, Peter Kersten's pastel chords and shuffling drums making minimalism feel like a mood rather than a rule.

albums.title: Thé au Harem d'Archimède
albums.why: Villalobos's Perlon album is looser and more Latin than Alcachofa, built from the long percussive grooves of his DJ sets.

albums.title: Suckfish
albums.why: Matthew Dear's tougher alias made the minimal house record of the Spectral Sound era, with Mouth to Mouth following as its anthem.

albums.title: We Are Monster
albums.why: The second Isolée album bends the sound further, with Schrapnell and My Hi-Matic; minimal house that behaves like pop.

albums.title: The Last Resort
albums.why: The Danish producer's debut turned minimal house into a widescreen, melancholy album, and it crossed over to listeners who owned no other dance records.

albums.title: Movements
albums.why: Body Language and Mandarine Girl made the Get Physical duo the melodic face of minimal, and the album holds up as songs.

albums.title: Panorama Bar 01
albums.why: The first Panorama Bar mix caught the Berlin minimal house moment at its peak, with Cassy's deep, swung selection as the standard.

albums.title: Orchestra of Bubbles
albums.why: The BPitch Control collaboration pairs Allien's minimal grooves with Apparat's melodic sound design; the Berlin sound at its most generous.

albums.title: Restore
albums.why: The Minus producer's debut album is the Hawtin camp's minimal house at its most accessible, with Bay of Figs as the stand-out.

albums.title: 23 Seconds
albums.why: Mathew Jonson's live trio improvised minimal house with jazz keys, and the album catches the Vancouver sound at its most fluid.

albums.title: This Bliss
albums.why: Chimes and bells over deep minimal grooves; Dial's most beloved album and the clearest case for minimal house as a romantic music.

albums.title: Efdemin
albums.why: Phillip Sollmann's debut is deep, jazz-harmonised minimal house, and Lohn & Brot and Just a Track remain Dial staples.

albums.title: 7 Dunham Place
albums.why: The Desolat founder's first album is minimal house with Ibiza-sized drums, the sound of the terrace circa 2008.

albums.title: Tribute to the Sun
albums.why: The Cadenza boss's album is minimal house with Chilean percussion and a sense of celebration; Los Niños de Fuera is its heart.

albums.title: Agents of Time
albums.why: Jonson's solo debut collects his melodic, synth-led minimal house in long tracks that reward a good system.

albums.title: Fabric 72
albums.why: The [a:rpia:r] founder's Fabric mix is the clearest document of the Romanian minimal house school, deep, dubby and unhurried.

albums.title: Donna
albums.why: Cassy's first artist album puts her voice over deep minimal house; a modest record, but a true one from a resident DJ.
